summary.text: The capital of the Nupe Kingdom (Bida Emirate) and seat of the Etsu Nupe. Its major people are the Nupe.

history.text: The old Nupe Kingdom arose in the mid-15th century between the Niger and Kaduna rivers. King Jibiri, around 1770, was the first Nupe king to become Muslim; after the Nupe civil wars the Fulani took the throne, and Bida became the emirate’s capital. The town is famous for its bronze and brass work.

livelihoods.text: Farming on arable land, with shea nuts, cashew, groundnut and rice sent out in large quantities; a gateway for the livestock trade.
